## Testing the weekly function for errors

```{r}
ERA5_phydro <- data.table::fread("~/Documents/CASSIA/data/ERA5_CASSIA_phydro.csv")
ERA5_preles <- data.table::fread("~/Documents/CASSIA/data/ERA5_CASSIA_preles.csv")

rphydro_nitrogen_longterm <- function(ERA5_phydro, ERA5_preles) {
  pa = calc_patm(150)
  nitrogen = 1
  fapar = 0.7
  
  kphio = 0.087         # quantum yield efficiency
  psi_soil = -0.05
  rdark = 0.015
  vwind = 3 # TODO: is this right?
  a_jmax = 800
  # par_cost = list(alpha=0.1, gamma=1, nitrogen_store_conversion = 1)
  par_cost = list(alpha=0.1, gamma=1)
  par_plant = list(conductivity=3e-17, psi50=-2, b=2)
  nitrogen_store_conversion = 0.1
  
  options = list(gs_method = "GS_IGF", 
               et_method = "ET_DIFFUSION",
               ftemp_vj_method = "FV_kumarathunge19",
               ftemp_rd_method = "FR_heskel16",
               ftemp_br_method = "FB_atkin15",
               scale_alpha = F)
  
  out <- list()
  for (i in 1:nrow(ERA5_phydro)) {
    out[[i]] <- rphydro_numerical(ERA5_phydro$T[i],         # 'C
                               # TODO: should this be a different temperature? Accumulated temperature?
                               ERA5_phydro$T[i],         # 'C 
                               ERA5_phydro$PPFD[i],      # umol/m2/s
                               ERA5_phydro$PPFD_max[i],  # max umol/m2/s
                               100 * ERA5_phydro$VPD[i], # Pa
                               ERA5_phydro$CO2[i],       # ppm
                               pa,                       # Pa
                               1,
                               fapar,                    # fraction
                               kphio,
                               psi_soil, 
                               rdark,
                               vwind, 
                               a_jmax,
                               par_plant,
                               par_cost,
                               options)
    cat("Day: ", i)
  }
  
  return(out)
}

boreal_result <- rphydro_nitrogen_longterm(ERA5_phydro, ERA5_preles)


```


## Testing the instant function for errors

```{r}
ERA5_phydro <- data.table::fread("~/Documents/CASSIA/data/ERA5_CASSIA_phydro.csv")
ERA5_preles <- data.table::fread("~/Documents/CASSIA/data/ERA5_CASSIA_preles.csv")

rphydro_nitrogen_longterm <- function(ERA5_phydro, ERA5_preles) {
  pa = calc_patm(150)
  nitrogen = 1
  fapar = 0.7
  
  kphio = 0.087         # quantum yield efficiency
  psi_soil
  rdark
  vwind
  a_jmax
  par_cost = list(biomass=0.01, gamma=1, nitrogen_store_conversion = 1)
  par_plant = list(conductivity=3e-17, psi50=-2, b=2)
  nitrogen_store_conversion = 0.1
  options = list(gs_method = "GS_IGF", 
               et_method = "ET_DIFFUSION",
               ftemp_vj_method = "FV_kumarathunge19",
               ftemp_rd_method = "FR_heskel16",
               ftemp_br_method = "FB_atkin15",
               scale_alpha = F)
  
  for (i in 1:nrow(ERA5_phydro)) {
    out[i] <- rphydro_instantaneous_nitrogen(ERA5_phydro$T[i],         # 'C
                                             # TODO: should this be a different temperature? Accumulated temperature?
                                             ERA5_phydro$T[i],         # 'C 
                                             ERA5_phydro$PPFD[i],      # umol/m2/s
                                             ERA5_phydro$PPFD_max[i],  # max umol/m2/s
                                             100 * ERA5_phydro$VPD[i], # Pa
                                             ERA5_phydro$CO2[i],       # ppm
                                             pa,                       # Pa
                                             nitrogen,                 # Store
                                             fapar,                    # fraction
                                             kphio, psi_soil, rdark, vwind, a_jmax, par_plant, par_cost, options)  
  }
}
```
